look.preset.hint: Applies a bundle of the options below. You can still change each one.
look.preset.tatakai.hint: Expressive, big spotlight banner, detailed cards.
look.preset.cinema.hint: Full-bleed artwork with a large title, slim rail, large cards with details, glass effects. Pairs well with AMOLED.
look.preset.dense.hint: Rows first, small cards, compact lists, quiet motion.
look.preset.calm.hint: No autoplay, soft motion, day view of the calendar.
look.style.hint: How a title's page and the Home banner are composed.
look.header.hint: How the facts, the actions and the next episode are arranged on a title's page.
look.header.line.hint: Facts on one line and a single block for watching.
look.header.nextup.hint: A card with the next episode, its progress and the source.
look.header.facts_nextup.hint: Labelled facts plus the episode card.
look.cards.hint: Poster cards in rows and grids.
look.card_size.hint: Large and Extra large show fewer cards per row with more detail: score, genres, the episode and when it aired.
look.rail.hint: Slim shows only icons; hover them for the name.
look.motion.hint: Hover, press and page transitions. Off is the same as Reduce motion.
look.glass.hint: Frosted glass behind badges and bars. Uses more GPU.
look.episodes.hint: Default view of the episodes in a title's page.
look.hero_autoplay.hint: Seconds per title. It pauses while the pointer is over it.
